verdict.rationale: a-Shell stores work as plain files/scripts and provides iOS file-sharing hooks (pickFolder, Shortcuts integration) that let users move files in and out of other apps' sandboxes, which supports data portability by nature of being a Unix-like terminal rather than a locked SaaS. However, there's no explicit 'export all your data' feature, no documented bulk-export or account-data-portability statement, and no independent corroboration of a full walk-away workflow. Missing for 10: an explicit data-export/backup feature, documentation of exporting configs/history/bookmarks together, and any third-party confirmation of full data portability.
